from collections import Counter
import random
import string


def generate_test_case():
    s_length = random.randint(0, 1000)
    s = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(s_length))
    t = list(s)
    t.append(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase))
    random.shuffle(t)
    t = ''.join(t)
    return s, t
